name: Armstrong
mentions: …the Indians who did sign it, about one hundred and forty in all, were frightened into it by threats of agent Armstrong that unless they consented, rations would be stopped April 1. None of the Crows want their reservation used for pasture, and say they will kill all cattle and men found…
Special agent Armstrong telegraphed Tuesday from Fort Reno, that there was no danger of trouble arising at the Arapahoe and Cheyenne agencies.
